exercise.name: Kettlebell Around Head Rotation

reference.title: Kettlebell Around Head Rotation
reference.listing: Video (movement reference; page could not be read at authoring time, title from the link)
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

exercise.mechanics: Compound (shoulder circumduction with elbow flexion and extension)

breathing.pattern: Breathe steadily; breathe out as the bell passes behind the head.

prescription.tempo: Slow and controlled, about 3 s per circle
prescription.frequency: 2-4 times a week, often as a warm-up
prescription.progression: Heavier bell, or half-kneeling to stop the trunk helping

cues.text: Stand tall, hold the kettlebell upside down by the handle in both hands in front of the chin.
Take it past the right ear, behind the head, past the left ear and back to the front, close to the head.
Pause in front, ribs down, then change direction.
Circle the other way: past the left ear, behind the head, past the right ear.
Pause in front with the bell still before the next circle.

mistakes.mistake: Leaning or arching the back to get the bell round
mistakes.fix: Brace the trunk and squeeze the glutes; only the arms move.
Keep the bell close to the head; the elbows do the work.
Keep the head still and the chin level; move the bell around it.
Slow, smooth circles; pause between directions.

kinematics.setup: Kettlebell upside down in front of the chin, handle 27 cm in front of the head centre
kinematics.peak: Handle circles the head at 23-27 cm from its centre; closest bell-to-body gap 3.65 cm, hands 5.04 cm from the head
kinematics.norm: The weight circles the head close to but not touching it (Harvard Health 2025)
Upper arms about at or above shoulder height through the circle; healthy men aged 20-44 averaged about 169 degrees of shoulder flexion (Soucie 2011)
Elbows bent; most bend as the bell passes behind the head (clinical opinion)

kinematics.peak: 3 s per circle, clockwise then counter-clockwise
kinematics.norm: Slow, about 3 s per circle, both directions (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual 6828, Kettlebell Around Head Rotation, video (movement reference)
Solan 2025, Coming full circle (the halo exercise), Harvard Health Publishing, reviewed by H. E. LeWine MD

Soucie, Wang, Forsyth, Funk, Denney, Roach, Boone and the Hemophilia Treatment Center Network 2011, range of motion measurements: reference values and a database for comparison studies (Haemophilia 17(3):500-507); values from the CDC Joint Range of Motion Study page

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Use a light bell and grip it firmly; keep clear space around you.
Shoulder pain or limited overhead mobility: make the circle smaller or use a lighter bell.
modify: Shoulder stiffness: smaller circles, bell lower around the head.
Grip tires: hold the bell by the horns or use a plate.

muscleNotes.core: Brace so the trunk stays still and the low back does not arch.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Lift and carry the bell in front and past the ears.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Lift and carry the bell in front and past the ears.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Hold the arms up beside the head.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Hold the arms up beside the head.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Rotate the shoulder blades up so the arms can go overhead.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Rotate the shoulder blades up so the arms can go overhead.
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_r: Take the arm back as the bell goes behind the head.
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_l: Take the arm back as the bell goes behind the head.
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Control the elbows as they bend and straighten round the head.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Control the elbows as they bend and straighten round the head.
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates and steadies the shoulder blades.
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates and steadies the shoulder blades.
muscleNotes.infraspinatus_r: Turns the upper arm out as the bell passes behind the head.
muscleNotes.infraspinatus_l: Turns the upper arm out as the bell passes behind the head.
muscleNotes.obliques_r: Stop the trunk twisting with the bell.
muscleNotes.obliques_l: Stop the trunk twisting with the bell.
